title: Local AI Websites options
description: Explicit enabled:false is a complete no-op, including stale options. Active options are validated strictly.

manifest.description: Explicit public JSON file, at most 262144 bytes, copied automatically for HTML panels. A relative URL resolves beside the input document; a /root-relative path resolves within the Quarto rendering context (project root, or input directory for a standalone document) and becomes a document-relative output URL, preserving site subpaths. Symbolic links, query, fragment, percent escapes, backslashes, whitespace and authored traversal are refused. Corrupted Quarto Unicode path values fail safely; the tested Windows locale requires an ASCII consumer/output directory for manifest publication. SDK, WASM and model assets require an exact author resources inventory; no directory is recursively copied. Omit for static search only.
